title: PDF preview uses Wasabi presign (proxy disabled)
description:
View PDF no longer calls the disabled proxy download endpoint. It uses an inline Wasabi presign, loads the bytes into a same-origin PDF blob, and shows that in the media viewer so the browser does not download or error on USE_PRESIGN.

Who is affected: PipeShare users opening report PDFs on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: PDF preview uses GET /api/files/presign/:id?inline=1 (proxy download stays disabled).
PDF bytes are wrapped in an application/pdf blob for the in-viewer iframe.
Workspace-switch remount still skips reloading the same open PDF.
